description: This file defines the `SearchResponse` class, which models the response of a search operation, including total count, entries, and facets.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: A Java class encapsulating the response data for a search query, including total entries, current entries, and search facets.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of search entries available.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of search entries available.

methods.name: setEntryCount
methods.description: Sets the number of entries returned in this response.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in this response.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of search entries in the response.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of search entries.

methods.name: setFacets
methods.description: Sets the facets map, which includes facet categories and their associated values.
